---
name: create-change
description: Create a small OpenSpec change with an unfinished task. Use in the SpecFlow e2e ladder to exercise the new_change postcondition.
---

Call the `write` tool to create `openspec/changes/demo-change/tasks.md` with
exactly this content:

    # Tasks

    - [ ] 1.1 Do the thing

Then reply with the single word `done`.
